title: Playwright MCP Browser Automation Patterns
description: Indexed skill patterns for Playwright MCP browser automation: snapshot hygiene, auth flows, clipboard bridge for secrets, React app interaction, popup/overlay handling, and CORS workarounds. Sourced from 2026-03-14 Madness Interactive dashboard configuration session.

patterns.title: Always snapshot before interact
patterns.rule: Take a fresh browser_snapshot before every interaction. Element refs go stale after any page mutation, navigation, or dialog open/close.

patterns.title: Scroll before off-screen interaction
patterns.rule: Always scroll the viewport to the target element before clicking or typing. Off-screen elements may fail silently or hit wrong targets.

patterns.title: Close popups and overlays first
patterns.rule: Before interacting with page elements, check for and dismiss any obstructing popups (Google Translate bar, cookie banners, notification modals, error toasts). These obstruct clicks and pollute snapshots. Examine them like a human would — close if irrelevant, act on them if they are part of the workflow.

patterns.title: Clipboard bridge for secrets
patterns.rule: Never pass API keys or secrets as plaintext in tool parameters. Use clipboard bridge: (1) shell: $env:SECRET | Set-Clipboard, (2) browser: click target field, (3) browser: Ctrl+A then Ctrl+V to paste. This keeps secret values out of tool call logs.

patterns.title: Auth does not persist across sessions
patterns.rule: OAuth/Auth0 sessions do not carry across Playwright browser sessions. User must manually log in via the Playwright-controlled browser for sites with OAuth. Plan for this handoff.

patterns.title: browser_run_code takes async (page) => {}
patterns.rule: browser_run_code expects a function string like 'async (page) => { ... }' — it runs in a Node.js Playwright context with the page object. NOT raw JS expressions.

patterns.title: browser_evaluate runs in page DOM context
patterns.rule: browser_evaluate takes '() => { ... }' and runs inside the browser page (has access to document, localStorage, window). Use for DOM manipulation. With a ref, use '(element) => { ... }' to operate on a specific element.

patterns.title: process.env not available in browser context
patterns.rule: browser_run_code and browser_evaluate do NOT have access to process.env. Environment variables must be read via shell commands and bridged through clipboard or passed as arguments to page.evaluate().

patterns.title: React controlled inputs hide value from DOM
patterns.rule: React controlled components may show text in snapshots but have empty input.value in DOM. Use Playwright's page.locator('input').nth(N).inputValue() to read the actual value, not document.querySelector('input').value.

patterns.title: Dropdown must be clicked and option selected
patterns.rule: Combobox/select dropdowns with prefilled text do NOT count as a proper selection. You MUST click the dropdown to open it, then click the desired option from the listbox. Skipping this causes the form to use stale/default values.

patterns.title: Force-click does not bypass React state guards
patterns.rule: Enabling a disabled button via DOM (removeAttribute('disabled')) and force-clicking it will NOT trigger React's internal onClick handler if the handler checks component state (e.g. testPassed). The save logic is guarded at the JS level, not just the DOM level.

patterns.title: localStorage as React config backdoor
patterns.rule: When React UI blocks saving (e.g. CORS test failure), write config directly to localStorage using browser_evaluate, then reload the page. React reads from localStorage on mount. Use browser_run_code with page.locator().inputValue() to extract field values that DOM queries miss.

patterns.title: Anthropic API blocks browser CORS
patterns.rule: Anthropic's API (api.anthropic.com) does not set CORS headers. Browser-side connection tests will always fail with 'Network error - CORS issue'. The API key may still be valid. OpenAI and Google Gemini APIs DO allow CORS.

patterns.title: Reload page after localStorage writes
patterns.rule: After writing to localStorage for a React app, you MUST reload the page (browser_navigate to same URL) for React to pick up the changes on next mount. React does not auto-watch localStorage.

steps.note: This skill is a reference document of indexed patterns. Read before any Playwright MCP browser automation session.
